comment: The design of the side-middle UI test (mitcad#2002; tools/ui-build-side-middle-test.sh): Upright (C1, Upright:1 O1, its derived part F1, its body F1.b0), the test library's 20x40 profile with two slots on each long side (LIBRARY_URL, replaced by the test) placed by BUILD standing at the origin, 500 long: its x+ side at x = 10 from y = -20 to 20, its slots at y = -10 and 10. All geometry is synthetic.
